# stb

`stb_image.h` supplies the shared Web/Telegram picture decoder.

`stb_sprintf.h` 1.10 supplies freestanding floating-point number formatting
for MuJS. It is vendored unmodified from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb)
at commit `f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5`. The upstream MIT/public-domain
license is included at the end of each header.
